why: A HIGH severity bug was found: firstName returns the last name instead of the first name. The function uses index [1] of split(' ') which returns the second word.

findings.title: firstName returns last name instead of first name
findings.body:
Function named 'firstName' uses index [1] of split(' ') which returns the second word (last name), not index [0] (first name). firstName('Ada Lovelace') returns 'Lovelace'.

User impact: Users will see 'Welcome back, Lovelace!' instead of 'Welcome back, Ada!'
findings.verified: Input traced through code: 'Ada Lovelace'.trim() → 'Ada Lovelace', .split(' ') → ['Ada', 'Lovelace'], [1] → 'Lovelace'

findings.title: Single name returns undefined
findings.body: When given a single name like "Ada", firstName returns undefined, which would produce "Welcome back, undefined!"

findings.title: Multiple names returns middle name
findings.body: When given a name with more than two words like "Ada Lovelace Byron", firstName returns the middle name "Lovelace"

pre_merge.detail: Test uses vague regex and doesn't catch the bug

walkthrough: Added welcomeBack(name) function that uses firstName(name) to get the user's name
firstName returns the second word of the name instead of the first

changes.summary: Added welcomeBack function with firstName helper
